name: height_left
source: 21 54 byte0 = left height; proven via variance session.log 2026-08-08. Normal band ~135–165 raw (≈1.4 mm per count): RDL 016 read 149/162; owners' NanoCom/Hawkeye logs 138–157 (landyzone 314170, 402791). Calibration-dependent: L and R may differ on level ground, so L≈R is not a health check. Fixed 0/255 = broken arm/sensor. See references/d2-tool-cross-reference.md.

description: Left ride-height sensor (raw 0–255, ≈1.4 mm per count). Typical ~135–165; calibration-dependent.

name: reverse_gear
source: 21 42 byte0 bit3; differential 2026-10-04 on D2-JW (automatic, engine off, ign on): P=82 28 / R=8A 30, 3x P and 3x R across P-R-P-R-P-R, automap state solve. re-read through the decoder on the car 2026-10-04 (R=1, P=0, steady) -> proven. Correction 2026-10-04: the second byte quoted (28/29/30/2C/38) is the frame checksum, which leaked into reads before the kwp2000 trim fix; 21 42 returns ONE data byte.
label: Reverse gear

name: neutral_gear
source: 21 42 byte0 bit0; differential 2026-10-04 on D2-JW (automatic, engine off, ign on): P=82 28 / N=83 29 / R=8A 30, N seen in two separate periods with P between. re-read through the decoder on the car 2026-10-04 (N=1, P=0, steady) -> proven. Correction 2026-10-04: the second byte quoted (28/29/30/2C/38) is the frame checksum, which leaked into reads before the kwp2000 trim fix; 21 42 returns ONE data byte.
label: Neutral gear
description: Neutral selected (automatic gearbox selector). Park also reads 0 here.

name: diff_lock
source: 21 42 byte0 bit4; differential 2026-10-04 on D2-JW (automatic, engine off, ign on, stationary): OFF=82 28 / ON=92 38, OFF-ON-OFF-ON, stable, 56/58 unchanged. Dash frozen in diag mode so engagement not seen visually; identity rests on the diff lock control toggling the bit. re-read through the decoder on the car 2026-10-04 (engaged=1, disengaged=0, steady) -> proven. Correction 2026-10-04: the second byte quoted (28/29/30/2C/38) is the frame checksum, which leaked into reads before the kwp2000 trim fix; 21 42 returns ONE data byte.
label: Centre diff lock

name: transfer_low
source: 21 42 byte0 bit2; 2026-10-04 on D2-JW (engine off, ign on, stationary): lever at end of travel HIGH=82 28 (bit clear), LOW=86 2C (bit set), plus 8 earlier low-range reads. A lever position the user felt was NEUTRAL (unsure) also read 82 28. Stays candidate until neutral is confirmed separately and the decoder is re-read on the car (test_plan T-29). Correction 2026-10-04: the second byte quoted (28/29/30/2C/38) is the frame checksum, which leaked into reads before the kwp2000 trim fix; 21 42 returns ONE data byte. T-29 2026-10-04 (engine idling, selector N, stationary): lever H 83 / N 83 / L 87 / N 83 / H 83 (3 reads each) -> bit2 set only in LOW; transfer NEUTRAL reads like HIGH (not visible in 21 42/56/58). Decoder re-read: L=1, H/N=0 -> proven.
label: Transfer box low range
description: Set when the transfer box is in low range.

name: brake_analog
label: Brake signal (raw)
description: Analogue brake-pedal signal on SLABS 21 48 (raw u16; falls when the pedal is pressed). Candidate, unscaled.
source: 21 48 u16, 2026-10-04 engine idling, stationary: brake released 0x96xx-0xA6xx (P and N alike), pressed firmly 0x3A3A-0x401F (sliding while held), back to 0x98xx-0x9Bxx immediately on release. Selector P/N alone does not move it. Analogue, not a switch; physical meaning (pressure vs travel) open, so unscaled. Earlier 'wanders on its own' = reads taken with the brake held. Re-read through the decoder on the car 2026-10-04 after a dashboard restart: released 40519, pressed 13155 (sliding to 15252 while held), released 42449 -> proven as a brake-pedal signal (raw; physical scale still open).
